What is CRISPR?.title: CRISPR
What is CRISPR?.extract: CRISPR is a family of DNA sequences found in bacteria and archaea.

What is CRISPR?.title: Cas9
What is CRISPR?.extract: Cas9 is an enzyme that cuts DNA at a site that a guide RNA selects.

How do vaccines train the immune system?.title: Vaccine
How do vaccines train the immune system?.extract: A vaccine is a biological preparation that gives active acquired immunity to a particular disease.

What causes ocean tides?.title: Tide
What causes ocean tides?.extract: Tides are the rise and fall of sea levels caused by the gravity of the Moon and the Sun.

How does photosynthesis work?.title: Photosynthesis
How does photosynthesis work?.extract: Photosynthesis takes place mainly in the chloroplasts of plant cells.

How does photosynthesis work?.title: Calvin cycle
How does photosynthesis work?.extract: The Calvin cycle uses energy from the light reactions to fix carbon dioxide into sugar.

What is a black hole?.title: Black hole
What is a black hole?.extract: Black holes form when very massive stars collapse at the end of their life.
